scope: official-current-source verification for five registered GlobalSaaSHub tools not included in prior reported audit batches

terms.commission: 22% of all qualifying subscription payments for the first 12 months per new paid subscriber
terms.payout_notes: official page describes reliable payouts; exact public minimum payout not confirmed in this audit

results.safety_note: Program terms must be accepted to join; do not auto-accept legal terms. Stop for user approval if/when the application reaches that consent step.

terms.official_conflict: current official signup portal states 40% one-time commission on the referral's first payment, while another current official Pictory partner page advertises recurring commissions up to 50%

results.safety_note: Do not submit an application until the active commercial terms are resolved from the actual application/terms flow; no duplicate application created.

terms.commission: 25% of the net amount of qualified Starter and Creator plan payments

terms.finding: current official Ambassador Program is selective and accepts rolling applications; its official FAQ includes an 'Affiliate link' resource, but the current public official sources retrieved in this audit do not state standard affiliate commission/cookie/payout terms

results.safety_note: Do not conflate the selective Ambassador Program with a standard revenue-share affiliate program; verify the affiliate-link destination/terms before any application.

terms.commission: $25 for each new Descript subscriber referred
terms.approval: official page says about one week
terms.network_change: official page says the program is migrating to PartnerStack and existing affiliates need to reapply

dedupe_rule: Existing individual application/result records override research-only classifications. Shared partner programs must not be applied to more than once. Already-completed UUIDs must not be recreated.
